ar26.title: Integrated Annual Report 2025-26
ar26.note: Filed with the exchanges on 7-Aug-2026 (letter Secl/AGM 25-26); accounts approved 18/19-May-2026

business.src: ar26 MD&A (group capacity 80.75 MMTPA -> ~98 MMTPA by 2027-28; India 258.1 MMTPA)

revenueByProductFY26.src: ar26 consolidated note 39 (external revenue incl. excise)

call.inventory: Finished-goods inventory gain ~Rs15,000 cr; crude inventory loss US$3-4/bbl (crude marked ~US$87/bbl at 31-Mar, ~US$83 at 30-Jun).
call.lpg: LPG under-recovery Rs665/cylinder in June (after the price revision), ~Rs475 in July, ~Rs250 expected as the Q2 average (Saudi CP 796 -> 592 -> 632). Confident of compensation 'based on past practice', timing and quantum uncertain.
call.crude: Indian basket US$100.74/bbl in Q1 vs US$83.01 in Q4FY26. Crude premium peaked ~US$10/bbl over Brent (all-in), US$2-3 in July; spot share 84% (51% a year earlier); Russian crude 50-54% of intake.
call.throughputGuide: ~77 MMT FY27, ~85 MMT FY28, ~90 MMT FY29 (standalone).
call.projects: Panipat 15->25 MMTPA (Rs38,231 cr, 94% complete, Dec-26); Gujarat 13.7->18 (Rs18,936 cr, 89%, Nov-26); Barauni 6->9 (Rs18,113 cr, 92%, Dec-26); PX-PTA Paradip (Rs13,805 cr, 95%, ~Aug-26); PBR Panipat (Rs2,949 cr, Dec-26); ~Rs90,000 cr in total. Ramp-up 60% / 80% / 100% over three years (Q4 call).
call.capexOutlook: Rs30,000-40,000 cr a year for the next 2-3 years; petchem intensity 6.5% -> 15% (~Rs1 lakh cr over 5-6 years, another ~5 MMTPA of petchem by FY30); 18 GW renewables in 3-4 years.
call.sprint: Project SPRINT saved ~Rs2,200 cr in FY26; SPRINT 2 targets Rs2,000-2,500 cr more in FY27.
call.pricing: Excise cut and price increases in tranches mitigated losses; ~10-15% of diesel is bulk sold at market prices; domestic ATF ~Rs115/litre to scheduled airlines.
call.borrowings: Rs1,41,453 cr at 30-Jun (Rs1,10,668 cr at 31-Mar): +Rs31,000 cr in one quarter on working capital, at higher rates.

q1fy27.notes: Audit Committee discontinued from 28-Mar-2026 for want of independent directors; Q1 results approved by the Board. Cumulative negative LPG buffer Rs29,729.95 cr at 30-Jun-2026; the Rs14,486 cr LPG compensation (approved Oct-2025) accrues in 12 monthly instalments from Nov-2025 (Rs3,621.51 cr in Q1FY27).

fy26.excise: Special additional excise duty cut by Rs10/litre on petrol (Rs13 -> Rs3) and diesel (Rs10 -> nil) on 27-Mar-2026, with retail prices unchanged; export duties of Rs21.5/litre on diesel and Rs29.5/litre on ATF reinstated (SAED on exports), reviewed fortnightly.
fy26.q4callNotes: FY26 profit 'largely insulated' from the war because of inventory bought at normal prices. GRM disclosure paused from Q4FY26 while volatility lasts. LPG under-recovery Rs100/cyl in Q4FY26, Rs171 in April, Rs670 in May 2026. Rupee 85.48 -> 94.84 in FY26; exchange loss the main reason other expenses rose.
